body.x: Erap Korea (CEO Mun Seung-yoon, www.erapkorea.co.kr) showcased general-purpose drones that can record stable videos without additional gimbals in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
The products are general-purpose drones that anyone can buy at an affordable price and easily use. The company showcased COSMIC (ED-560M), Nimble (ED-550M), and ED-700, among others.

These products have a system that can track a subject in a video by using an automatic tracking function. With an automation system, users can easily control the taking-off and landing of the product. In particular, it can shoot stable videos even without additional gimbals.
It has a foldable body and a camera installation device, and it can control the pitch of a camera. It supports GOPRO action cams with a waterproof case and DSLR cameras.

Erap Korea CEO Mun Seung-yoon said: “We will examine the technological trends of the ever-changing drone market at CES 2016. We will establish a bridgehead for advancing into the American market, and begin in earnest the domestic public drone business.”

Since its foundation in 2002, the company has conducted research and developed products for ground support and on-board equipment, MRO services, and drone and UAV fields, all under the slogan, “A leading company that creates optimized solutions in the aerospace industry.”

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the infrastructure project of smart drone application technology for security and convenience services. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
